consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the performance of the Grateful Dead at The Spectrum on September 21, 1972, highlighting the exceptional quality of the music throughout the show. The standout moments include a mesmerizing 'Dark Star' that transitions into 'Morning Dew,' which many reviewers consider one of the best versions of this pairing ever performed.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 71 reviews + 1.5 sentiment: The overwhelming enthusiasm and high praise from fans for the performance, particularly the 'Dark Star > Morning Dew' sequence, significantly elevate the sentiment beyond neutral.
